claims: Monitor electrolyte levels (potassium, magnesium, calcium) closely.
Administer intravenous potassium chloride to maintain serum potassium level.
Continue intravenous fluid support (0.9% Sodium Chloride) to maintain hydration.
Assess and manage hypertension (non-invasive blood pressure).
Monitor respiratory status (oxygen saturation, respiratory rate).
Assess the patient for signs of anxiety or agitation.
Continue monitoring for signs of delirium or cognitive decline.
Monitor for signs of infection (elevated white blood cell count, fever).
Monitor patient for signs of renal impairment (creatinine, BUN).
Monitor and manage pain (pain level, pain medications).
